items.title: Crypto Sentiment Flips to Extreme Greed Amid Bitcoin Rally
points: CoinMarketCap's Crypto Fear and Greed Index hit 'extreme greed' Tuesday, the first time since late 2024, up from neutral the prior week.
Bitcoin gained more than 20% in a single week, driving frothy sentiment across the market.
Historically, such extreme greed readings have preceded market pullbacks, making timing critical for risk management.

items.title: Bitcoin Futures Market Matures: Dollar Collateral Replaces Crypto
points: Crypto-backed Bitcoin open interest (the total value of outstanding futures contracts) collapsed to just 12% of total futures positions, down from near 100% dominance in 2019-2020.
Dollar-backed stablecoins (crypto assets pegged 1:1 to the US dollar) are now the primary collateral for Bitcoin derivatives, signaling market maturation.
Despite lower crypto collateral usage, leveraged traders continue placing substantial bets, showing the derivatives market remains active even as its composition evolves.

items.title: XRP Leads Pullback as Leverage Unwind Tests Rally
points: XRP led losses among top-10 cryptocurrencies as leverage unwinds (traders closing borrowed positions) test the sustainability of the recent rally.

items.title: Roman Storm's Tornado Cash Retrial Delayed to April 2027
points: Judge Katherine Polk Failla postponed Roman Storm's Tornado Cash retrial by more than six months, to April 2027.
His motion for acquittal remains undecided, extending legal uncertainty.
Storm is accused of helping operate Tornado Cash, a privacy-focused cryptocurrency mixing service that obscures the origin of transactions.

items.title: Revolut Launches Euro-Pegged EURR Stablecoin
points: Revolut's new EURR stablecoin (a cryptocurrency designed to maintain a 1:1 value with the euro) went live for selected customers in Denmark, Poland, and Portugal.
A Luxembourg subsidiary of Stripe holds the reserves backing EURR, providing institutional backing for the new euro-denominated digital asset.

headlines: Crypto sentiment index hit "extreme greed" for first time since late 2024 as Bitcoin surged more than 20% in a week, signaling frothy trader optimism.
Bitcoin futures traders have largely shifted from using crypto as collateral to using dollar-backed stablecoins, with crypto-backed open interest falling to 12% from near 100% in 2019-2020.
XRP led losses among top-10 cryptocurrencies as leverage unwinds test the recent rally's sustainability.
Roman Storm's Tornado Cash retrial was pushed to April 2027, with his motion for acquittal still pending.
Revolut launched its euro-pegged EURR stablecoin in Denmark, Poland, and Portugal, with reserves held by a Luxembourg subsidiary of Stripe.

sections.title: Crypto Sentiment Flips to Extreme Greed Amid Bitcoin Rally
points: CoinMarketCap's Crypto Fear and Greed Index hit "extreme greed" Tuesday, the first time since late 2024, jumping from neutral the prior week as traders adopted an increasingly optimistic stance.
Bitcoin gained more than 20% in a single week, driving the frothy sentiment across the market despite other sentiment trackers remaining more conservative.
The sentiment shift reflects growing trader confidence but historically has preceded market pullbacks, making timing critical for risk management.

sections.title: Bitcoin Futures Market Matures: Dollar Collateral Replaces Crypto
points: Crypto-backed Bitcoin open interest collapsed to just 12% of total futures positions, down from near 100% dominance in 2019-2020, reflecting a structural shift in how leveraged traders fund their bets.

Dollar-backed stablecoins (meaning crypto assets whose value is pegged to the U.S. dollar) are now the primary collateral for Bitcoin derivatives, signaling market maturation and reduced reliance on volatile crypto collateral.
Despite lower crypto collateral usage, leveraged traders continue placing substantial bets, indicating the derivatives market remains active even as its composition evolves.

sections.title: Legal and Regulatory Updates

The delay extends legal uncertainty for Storm, who is accused of helping operate Tornado Cash, a privacy-focused cryptocurrency mixing service.
